E0405

`??` fallback type/`return` mismatch

What

`??` fallback type/`return` mismatch

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0405

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0405: tests/ui/E0405_refutable_test_bind_route_must_diverge.stderr.

Error [E2417]: explicit failure domain `String (text)` is not an Error type
  --> tests/ui/E0405_refutable_test_bind_route_must_diverge.jet:1:16
    |
  1 | fn parse_age() Int !String -> { return .Ok(42) }
    |                ^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A `!` contract may name `Err`, a Core error, a type marked `#Error`, an all-error union, or `Never`; arbitrary value types do not describe failures.
 Fix: use a Core error, add `#Error` to a local error type, or remove the explicit error contract.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E2417

Error [E0330]: can't infer the enum type for `.Ok`
  --> tests/ui/E0405_refutable_test_bind_route_must_diverge.jet:1:40
    |
  1 | fn parse_age() Int !String -> { return .Ok(42) }
    |                                        ^^^^^^^
 Why: a leading-dot variant needs a known enum type from context
 Fix: add a type annotation, or write the full form `EnumName.Ok`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0330

Error [E0305]: pattern `Ok` doesn't match Int (a whole number)
  --> tests/ui/E0405_refutable_test_bind_route_must_diverge.jet:3:12
    |
  3 | fn run() { parse_age() == .Ok(age) ?? 0 }
    |            ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: variant patterns only work on enum values
 Fix: test an enum value, or use `Val` / `None` for optionals
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0305

Error [E0405]: `??` must diverge after a refutable binding
  --> tests/ui/E0405_refutable_test_bind_route_must_diverge.jet:3:39
    |
  3 | fn run() { parse_age() == .Ok(age) ?? 0 }
    |                                       ^
 Why: a failed pattern match cannot continue without defining the captures
 Fix: use `return`, `panic(...)`, `break`, or `next` as the fallback
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0405
